title: Fix puzzle image tiles not rendering in 3x3 sliding puzzle

requirements.summary: Fix the 3x3 sliding tile puzzle so that couple-ayce.jpg renders correctly as individual tiles using CSS background-image with calculated background-position to slice the correct portion of the image per tile index
acceptanceCriteria: Each tile in the 3x3 grid displays the correct cropped region of couple-ayce.jpg using CSS background-image and background-position/background-size.
When all tiles are in solved order, the full couple-ayce.jpg photo is visible as a seamless image across the grid.
The empty tile (blank space) has no background image rendered.
The image loads without broken image indicators or blank white tiles.
The puzzle remains functional — tiles can be slid, move counter increments, and completion detection still works.

file_operations.description: Update the tile rendering logic in the puzzle grid to use CSS background-image with /assets/generated/couple-ayce.jpg as the source. For each tile (except the empty tile at index 8), calculate the background-position based on the tile's value to display the correct 1/9th slice of the image. Set background-size to 300% (3 times tile width) so the full image spans the 3x3 grid. Use inline styles or className to apply background-image: url('/assets/generated/couple-ayce.jpg'), background-size: 300% 300%, and background-position calculated as ((value % 3) * -100%) ((Math.floor(value / 3)) * -100%) where value is the tile's original position (0-8). Ensure the empty tile (index 8 or value 8) renders with no background image. Verify the existing puzzle functionality (tile sliding, move counter, completion detection) remains intact.
